description: §5.2 rules 2–3 (S457), the parenthesized expression form: an SVG animation value `to=(@cell)` / `values=(@cell)` whose static `attributeName` names a URL attribute — or whose `attributeName` is computed — is judged at runtime against the animated attribute; `values` judges every `;` entry; a static non-URL `attributeName` leaves the value unjudged. Written in forms both implementations compile (s462-bootstrap-sink-guards — the bootstrap's twin of svg-animation-url-runtime-guard, whose `${…}` forms the bootstrap does not parse).
rationale: §5.2 rule 2 *SVG animation values (S457)*: `to`/`from`/`by`/`values` on `<set>`/`<animate>`/… IS a URL-valued attribute "when `attributeName` is written as a static string naming an attribute of the URL-valued list … and ALSO when `attributeName` is not a static string". Rule 3 *SVG animation values*: "The judgment is made against the animated attribute (`\"about:blank\"` replaces the whole value); `values` judges every `;`-separated entry … When `attributeName` is not a static string, the value is judged as a URL on an unknown attribute".
